  *****NOTE FROM THE CITY*****

Doors to the City Council Chamber will open at 1:30 p.m. for Open Session. Please be mindful that seating is
limited and available on a first come, first served basis.

ALTERNATIVE METHODS
The City provides the following two alternative methods of viewing and listening to the City Council Meeting
as a convenience:

    On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your cable provider
  for details.
    Live  online  through  Facebook  Live,  with  audio  and  limited  video,
  at https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/

The disruption in service of any alternative method does not preclude the City Council or other legislative
body from taking further action on an agenda item.

Submitting Comments Prior to Public Meeting: Members of the public may choose to submit comments
electronically for consideration by the City Council or other City Legislative Body by sending them to the
City  Clerk/Secretary  at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and  Deputy  City  Clerk  at
dwesley@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to
consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 8:00 a.m. the day of the meeting, and in the
body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the
meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 a.m. and prior to the close of the public hearings
will be made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310-
412-5280 with any questions.

ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities
Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and regulations adopted in implementation
thereof. Any person who requires a disability-related modification or accommodation, or translation services
in order to observe and/or offer public comment may request such reasonable modification, accommodation,
or service by contacting the Office of the City Clerk by telephone at 310-412-5280, FAX at 310-412-5533,
One Manchester Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301 or via email to
athompson@cityofinglewood.org and dwesley@cityofinglewood.org no later than 24 hours prior to the
scheduled meeting.

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  March 27, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on March 27, 2025 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera , Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt.Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service Department
  Kenrick Sanderlin ,Public Works Department – 2:03 pm

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Synaelyn Thomas, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on March 13, 2025.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Daniel Medina on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host an Easter Eggstravaganza Event at
  700 Warren Ln; Edward Vincent Jr. Park; on Saturday, April 05, 2025, Public Property, from
  11:00 a.m. -2:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for one (1) day event at
  Edward Vincent Park. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the park; IPD will staff one
  (1) sergeant and two( 2) police officers to this event for public safety; Emory Ward will deploy
  a minimum of four (4) security officers to assist IPD with any potential crowd control and
  monitoring of the restrooms to prevent any potential lewd activity for the safety of the children
  attendees; No additional requirements for Fire approval; Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00405244)
 Permits & License Committee  March 27, 2025
Minutes  Page 2 of 5

Item #2:  Daniel Medina on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host an Inglewood Stem Fest Event at
  700 Warren Ln; Edward Vincent Jr. Park- Champion Field; on Saturday, April 12, 2025,
  Public Property, from 9:00 a.m. -1:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for
  one (1) day event at Edward Vincent Park. Subject to Parks & Recreation approval for use
  of the park; IPD will staff two (2) police officers to this event for public safety; Emory Ward
  will deploy a minimum of two (2) security officers to assist IPD with any potential crowd
  control and monitoring of the restrooms to prevent any potential lewd activity for the safety
  of the children attendees;No additional requirements for Fire approval; Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00405245)

Item #3:  Juan Rodriguez on behalf of RJ’s Demolition & Disposal to host a Dia Del Jardinero Event
  at 1135 East Florence Ave on Wednesday, May 07, 2025, Public Property, from 7:00 a.m.
  -4:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for one (1) day event within private
  property; IPD will staff two (2) professional / licensd security guards for the safety of
  attendees; a Watch Commander will be notified and extra patrol provided as time permits;
  Applicant/Employees/Agents to comply with City's Noise Standards (IMC Chapter 5 Article
  2). Copy of permit to be on-site and subject to inspection by any Code Enforcement Officer
  and/or Police Officer; No additional requirements for Fire approval; Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00405284)

New Business License Request (s):
Item #4:  Otto Maly on behalf of YouTube Theater to operate as Shows / Exhibits / Special Events
  at 1001 S. Stadium Dr. Approval for live entertainment at a theater. Subject to the HPSP.
  Subject to all applicable IMC regulation; Applicant to provide valid identification and all
  employees upon request from IPD /ABC and Code Enforcement;Applicant shall ensure
  Complete Unrestricted Access to the entire facility / venue to all "on-duty" first responder
  personnel (Law Enforcement, Fire, Code Enforcement, etc). ANY Drone usage shall be
  approved by SoFi Stadium / You Tube Management and the LAX Tower in writing prior to
  use or deployment; The City of Inglewood SHALL be notified before any drone usage;
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00404810)

Item #5:  Sulaiman Wali DBA American Global Security to operate as a Guard Service at One West
  Machester Blvd. Approved conditionally; Applicant shall submit a list of all current
  employees (to include valid California ID and applicable state Bureau of Security &
  Investigative Service permits) working within the city, a list of registered / insured vehicles
  to be used and if applicable and or permitted, a current list of locations where services will
  be rendered (needed BEFORE license-permit issuance). In the interest of public safety,
  This business shall NOT employ or have any 290 PC sex offender registrants employed at
  this establishment or any persons that may pose a threat to public safety; Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00405268)
 Permits & License Committee  March 27, 2025
Minutes  Page 3 of 5

Item #6:  Shuree Rivera DBA Culture Cart Inc. to operate as a Pedicab at 3742 W Century Blvd
  Suite #5; Approved Conditionally; The applicant must ensure that all drivers and employees
  possess state licenses, maintain full-coverage insurance;operate all pedicabs in
  compliance with the California Vehicle Code and the City of Inglewood ordinance
  guidelines;Applicant must keep safety and maintenance records for all pedicabs and
  ensure they remain in safe, operable condition at all time; Golf carts are strictly prohibited
  from being used as pedicabs.All operators must strictly follow the designated route
  guidelines established to promote traffic safety. For public safety, this business shall not
  employ or engage any individuals registered under Penal Code 290 or any persons who
  may pose a threat to the safety of patrons or the general public; No staging on private
  property until granted approval from the property owner; routes are tentative; Adhere to all
  local, state and federal laws; Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405125)

Item #7:  Leon Butler DBA Urban Xpress to operate as a Pedicab at 351 East Beach Ave Approved
  Conditionally; The applicant must ensure that all drivers and employees possess state
  licenses, maintain full-coverage insurance;operate all pedicabs in compliance with the
  California Vehicle Code and the City of Inglewood ordinance guidelines;Applicant must
  keep safety and maintenance records for all pedicabs and ensure they remain in safe,
  operable condition at all time; Golf carts are strictly prohibited from being used as
  pedicabs.All operators must strictly follow the designated route guidelines established to
  promote traffic safety. For public safety, this business shall not employ or engage any
  individuals registered under Penal Code 290 or any persons who may pose a threat to the
  safety of patrons or the general public; No staging on private property until granted approval
  from the property owner; routes are tentative; Adhere to all local, state and federal laws;
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405076)
